blurb: Skydive Toledo offers skydiving experiences above the Pacific Northwest, including tandem jumps from 15,000 feet and Accelerated Free Fall (AFF) training to learn to skydive solo. The dropzone has over 50 years of family-owned operation and a tight-knit community. Guests can also purchase media packages to capture their jumps.
